title: 6-Month Placement Program
deliveryMode: On campus, 3 days a week, plus a weekly online contest
summary: Starts in pre-final year. Strong DSA, two deployed projects, aptitude and mock interviews, so students are ready before the placement season opens.
outcome: Pre-final year students reach placement season with interview-level DSA, two deployed projects on their resume and mock interviews already done.
eligibility: Pre-final year B.E./B.Tech (CSE, IT, ECE and allied branches), MCA

curriculum.title: DSA foundations
curriculum.description: Complexity, arrays, strings, hashing and recursion, with a weekly contest from week 2.
curriculum.aiPractice: Solutions are written without AI. An AI tutor gives hints and explanations only.

curriculum.title: Advanced DSA and core CS
curriculum.description: Trees, graphs and dynamic programming at interview level, plus DBMS, OS, networks and OOP.
curriculum.aiPractice: AI explains concepts and generates extra test cases. Every solution is the student's own.

curriculum.title: Full-stack project
curriculum.description: A React, Node.js and MongoDB app with authentication, reviewed and deployed.
curriculum.aiPractice: Students pair-program with an AI assistant and must explain every change it suggests.

curriculum.title: AI-powered project
curriculum.description: Add an AI feature to the app using an LLM API, then build a small document Q&A tool.
curriculum.aiPractice: Students learn how AI features are built, tested and shipped in real products.

curriculum.title: Aptitude and online assessments
curriculum.description: Quantitative, logical and verbal aptitude, plus company-pattern coding rounds under time.
curriculum.aiPractice: Students practice spotting and fixing mistakes in AI-generated code.

curriculum.title: Mock interviews and company sprints
curriculum.description: Technical and HR mock interviews with feedback, GD practice, resume polish and prep for each visiting company.
curriculum.aiPractice: Includes a timed round without AI and a round where AI tools are allowed, as some companies now do.

assessments: Weekly coding contests, 2 graded projects, 4 full mock online assessments and 3 mock interviews
certificate: CodingMonk completion certificate and a placement-readiness report for each student

title: 2-Month Placement Sprint
deliveryMode: On-campus bootcamp, 5 days a week, 3 hours a day
summary: An intensive program right before placement drives: aptitude, coding rounds, core CS, resume and mock interviews for every company type.
outcome: Final-year students go into the placement season prepared for online assessments, technical rounds and HR rounds.

curriculum.title: Aptitude and reasoning
curriculum.description: Quantitative, logical and verbal aptitude with speed techniques.
curriculum.aiPractice: AI generates extra practice sets. Students solve them without AI.

curriculum.title: Coding round basics
curriculum.description: Arrays, strings and patterns that appear in online assessments.
curriculum.aiPractice: Solutions are written without AI to build speed and confidence.

curriculum.title: Company-pattern coding
curriculum.description: Online-assessment style problems for service-based and product-based companies, under time.
curriculum.aiPractice: AI reviews finished solutions and explains better approaches.

curriculum.title: Core CS revision
curriculum.description: DBMS, OS, computer networks, OOP and SQL.
curriculum.aiPractice: Revision with an AI tutor that quizzes students and explains weak areas.

curriculum.title: Resume and project
curriculum.description: A reviewed resume for every student and an AI feature added to their best project.
curriculum.aiPractice: Students learn to describe how they used AI tools in their projects honestly.

curriculum.title: Technical mock interviews
curriculum.description: One-to-one technical mocks with written feedback.
curriculum.aiPractice: Includes explaining and fixing AI-written code, a question companies now ask.

curriculum.title: HR rounds and GD
curriculum.description: HR mock interviews, group discussions and communication practice.
curriculum.aiPractice: AI is used for extra speaking practice between sessions.

curriculum.title: Company sprints
curriculum.description: Mock tests and preparation for each company visiting your campus, plus a final readiness report.

assessments: Daily practice sets, 4 full mock online assessments and 2 mock interviews
certificate: CodingMonk completion certificate and a placement-readiness report for each student

timelineMilestones.title: Aptitude, coding rounds and core CS

title: Mock Interview Drive
deliveryMode: On campus with a panel of interviewers
summary: A week of one-to-one technical and HR mock interviews, with written feedback for every student.
outcome: Every student gets a mock interview with written feedback, and the TPO gets a batch summary.

curriculum.title: Technical mock interviews
curriculum.description: DSA, project and core CS questions.
curriculum.aiPractice: Includes one question on reviewing AI-written code.

curriculum.title: HR mock interviews and report
curriculum.description: HR rounds, feedback sessions and the batch summary for the TPO.

assessments: One technical and one HR mock interview per student

title: AI Project Workshop
summary: Students build and demo a working AI-powered web app in two days: a strong project for the resume.
outcome: Every team demos a working app that uses an LLM API, and understands how it works.

curriculum.title: How AI features are built
curriculum.description: LLM APIs, prompts, and building the app interface in React.
curriculum.aiPractice: Students build with AI assistants and review every change.

curriculum.title: Build, test and demo
curriculum.description: Connecting the AI feature, testing it, and team demos.
curriculum.aiPractice: Teams explain where AI helped and where they had to fix it.
